viewer.emptyTitle: Open a PDF to get started
viewer.emptyBody: Your files stay on this device.

errors.invalid_pdf: This file could not be read. It may be damaged, or it is not a PDF.
errors.engine_unavailable: The PDF engine could not start. Reinstalling Mirsam should fix this.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.file_missing: That file has been moved or deleted.
errors.print_failed: The document could not be printed. Check the printer and try again.
errors.searchInvalid: That search cannot be run. Check the regular expression.
errors.searchFailed: The search could not be completed.
errors.edit_unsupported: This file's structure can't be edited yet. Viewing still works.
errors.invalid_edit: That change can't be made to this document.
errors.save_failed: The document could not be saved. The file on disk was not changed.
errors.io_error: The file could not be read or written. Check that its folder exists and can be written to.
errors.text_failed: The text could not be set.
errors.no_bookmarks: This document has no top-level bookmarks to split at.
errors.redaction_failed: The redaction was stopped because the marked text could still be read afterwards. Nothing was changed.
errors.password_not_encodable: That password can't be used with this encryption. Use AES-256 for passwords with other letters.
errors.not_permitted: This file's owner password is needed to change its protection.
errors.store_unavailable: Mirsam's local storage is unavailable, so signatures cannot be kept.
errors.no_image: Choose an image for the watermark first.
errors.image_unreadable: That image can't be used. Choose a PNG or JPEG file under 50 MB.
errors.compress_stale: The document changed after it was compressed. Compress it again.
errors.model_unknown: This OCR model is not offered in this version of Mirsam.
errors.model_busy: That model is downloading. Cancel the download first.
errors.model_unavailable: OCR models cannot be installed: Mirsam has no data folder on this computer.
errors.model_download_failed: The download stopped. Check the internet connection and try again: it continues where it stopped.
errors.model_checksum_mismatch: The downloaded file was not the expected one, so it was deleted. Try again.
errors.model_disk_full: There is not enough free disk space for the OCR model.
errors.model_archive_invalid: The OCR engine could not be unpacked. Try again.
errors.model_install_failed: The OCR model could not be installed. Check that there is free disk space and try again.
errors.image_too_large: That image file is too large: 64 MB at most.
errors.link_refused: Only web and e-mail links are opened.
errors.certificate_password: That password does not open this certificate file. Try again.
errors.certificate_unreadable: This certificate file could not be read. Choose a .p12 or .pfx file that holds a certificate with its private key.
errors.key_unsupported: This certificate's key type is not supported. Mirsam signs with RSA and ECDSA (P-256, P-384) keys.
errors.certificate_cannot_sign: This certificate cannot sign now: it has expired, is not valid yet, or is not meant for signing.
errors.timestamp_failed: The time-stamping server could not be reached, or it refused. Nothing was signed. Check its address and the internet connection, or sign without a time-stamp.
errors.timestamp_url: Enter the time-stamping server's address, starting with http:// or https://.
errors.signing_failed: The document could not be signed. If the keychain asked, allow Mirsam to use the key.
errors.signature_too_large: The signature is too large to fit in the document.
errors.keychain_unavailable: The keychain could not be read.
errors.save_as_required: The original file changed since it was opened. Choose “as…” to save to a new file.

panel.label: Side panel
panel.noDocument: Open a document to see its pages here.

unlock.title: Password required
unlock.insertBody: Enter the password to insert pages from
unlock.wrong: That password is not correct. Try again.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.tab: Save the changes to this document before closing it?
unsaved.window: Some documents in this window have unsaved changes. Close it anyway?
unsaved.quit: Some documents have unsaved changes. Quit anyway?

recovery.title: Recover unsaved changes?
recovery.message: Mirsam closed before these documents were saved. Their latest changes were kept.
recovery.changed: The original file has changed since. Save the recovered version as a new file.

notices.split: The document was split into {{count}} files.

textNotEditable.shared: This text is drawn together with other text, so it can't be edited on its own yet.
textNotEditable.unreadable: This text can't be read reliably, so it can't be edited. Run OCR on it first.
textNotEditable.font: This text's font can't be read for editing yet.
textNotEditable.rotated: Rotated text can't be edited yet.
textNotEditable.encrypted: Text in encrypted files can't be edited yet.
textNotEditable.unsupported: This text is drawn in a way that can't be edited yet.

notices.compressedSaved: The compressed copy was saved as {{name}}.
notices.ocrNotYet: The OCR model is installed. Recognizing pages arrives in a coming update.

split.title: Split into files
split.sizeHelp: Each file holds as many pages as fit. A page larger than this gets a file of its own.
split.noBookmarks: This document has no top-level bookmarks on different pages.
split.help: Each file gets this many pages, in order; the last one gets the rest.

pageText.label: New text
pageText.text: Text to add to the page

comments.empty: No comments in this document yet.
comments.author: Author
comments.yourNamePlaceholder: Not set: comments carry no name

protect.hint: Drag on a page to mark an area for redaction, or find text below.
protect.findLabel: Find text or a pattern to redact
protect.sanitizeHint: Remove what a file carries besides its pages.

securityDialog.title: Password and permissions
securityDialog.currentOpen: This file has no password and no restrictions.

cipherName.unknown: a kind of protection Mirsam can't write

securityDialog.needsOwner: You opened this file with its user password. Its owner password is needed to change or remove its protection: close it and open it again with the owner password.
securityDialog.modeSet: Protect with a password or permissions
securityDialog.aes128: AES-128 (for older readers; ASCII passwords only)
securityDialog.ownerHint: The owner password lifts the permissions below. Leave it empty and nobody can lift them.

problem.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
problem.nothing: Set a password or turn off a permission.
problem.ascii: AES-128 takes only English letters, digits and symbols. Choose AES-256 for other passwords.

securityDialog.saveNote: Saving rewrites the file with this protection and clears undo. Passwords can't be recovered if you forget them.

redactDialog.title: Apply redactions?
redactDialog.body: This removes the marked content from the document: the text, image pixels, drawings, and annotations under {{marks}} marked areas, and any mention of the marked text in its metadata. A black box covers each area. You can undo this until you save; once saved, it cannot be undone.

block.label: Page text
block.ownFont: Set in the paragraph's own font ({{font}}) where it has the letters.
block.substituted: Font substituted: the paragraph is set in a bundled font instead of {{font}}.
block.styled: Its bold, italic, sizes and colours are kept; text you type takes the style of the text before it.

forms.unreadable: This document's form fields cannot be read.
forms.none: This document has no form fields to fill in. Use Fill & Sign to type, tick, and sign anywhere on its pages.
forms.xfa: This document also has an XFA form, which Mirsam does not support. Readers that use XFA may not show what you fill in here.
forms.needAppearances: Mirsam draws every field itself when you first fill one, so Arabic shows correctly in every reader.
forms.notPermitted: This file's permissions do not allow filling in its form. Its owner password lifts that.

sign.tools: What a click on the page places

hint.select: Click an item you placed to select it. Drag it, even onto another page, or use the arrow keys, to move it.
hint.text: Click on the page where the text goes.
hint.date: Click on the page where today's date goes.
hint.dot: Click each place to mark with a dot.
hint.signature: Click on the page where the signature goes.
hint.certificate: Click on the page where the certificate signature goes. The document is signed and saved at once.

sign.keptLocally: Signatures are kept on this device only.
sign.notPermitted: This file's permissions do not allow adding to its pages. Its owner password lifts that.
sign.colorHint: New text, dates and marks take this colour. Choosing one also recolours the selected text or mark.
sign.certificateHint: A digital signature with your certificate proves who signed and shows any later change. Signing saves the file.

signature.title: New signature
signature.drawHint: Sign with the mouse, a pen, or a finger.
signature.imageHint: A PNG or JPEG of your signature. A PNG with a transparent background looks best.

output.rangeHelp: Pages 1 to {{last}}, separated by commas; an open end runs to the last page.

headerFooter.title: Header or footer
headerFooter.tokens: Type {page} for the page number and {pages} for the last one.

exportText.title: Export text
exportText.help: Text is written in reading order, so Arabic copies and searches correctly.

compress.title: Compress
compress.help: Unused objects are removed. Your document is not changed: the result is saved as a copy.
compress.kept: {{count}} images were kept as they are (JPEG and other formats are not reduced yet).

settings.title: Settings
settings.digitsHint: Page numbers, counts and zoom. Numbers inside documents are not changed.

ocrModels.heading: OCR models
ocrModels.intro: Text recognition runs on this computer, so your documents never leave it. Each model is downloaded once and kept until you delete it.
ocrModels.unavailable: Models cannot be installed: Mirsam has no data folder on this computer.

role.primary: Reads the page. Needed for OCR.
role.ensemble: A second reader that double-checks numbers and unclear words. Optional.
role.runtime: Runs the models on this computer. Needed for OCR.
role.draft: A quick first reading, replaced by the full one.

ocrModels.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Using it again means downloading {{size}}.
ocrModels.diskFull: Not enough disk space: it needs {{needed}} free, and {{available}} is free.

hardware.vulkan: Acceleration: the graphics card, through Vulkan.
hardware.none: No graphics acceleration Mirsam can use was found, so OCR runs on the processor: expect a few minutes a page.

ocrPrompt.title: Download the OCR model?
ocrPrompt.body: Mirsam reads scanned pages with {{name}}, which runs on this computer: your documents never leave it.
ocrPrompt.size: It is a one-time download of {{size}}, kept until you delete it in Settings.
ocrPrompt.slow: This computer has no graphics acceleration Mirsam can use, so OCR will be slow: a few minutes a page.

ocrPanel.missing: The OCR model is not installed yet. It is a {{size}} download.

formDesign.tools: What dragging on the page draws

hint.select: Click a field to select it; drag it to move it, or a corner to resize it. Pick a kind of field above to draw one.
hint.text: Drag on the page to draw a text field, or click to place one.
hint.checkbox: Drag or click on the page to place a check box.
hint.radio: Drag or click to place a radio group's first button; add more buttons below.
hint.combo: Drag on the page to draw a drop-down list.
hint.list: Drag on the page to draw a list box.
hint.pushButton: Drag on the page to draw a push button. It runs no scripts.

formDesign.notPermitted: This file's permissions do not allow changing its form. Its owner password lifts that.
formDesign.noSelection: Select a field on the page, or in the tab order below, to change it.
formDesign.name: Name
formDesign.nameHint: What the field is called when the form is filled in or exported. No full stops.
formDesign.maxLenHint: Characters; leave empty for no limit.
formDesign.caption: Label
formDesign.alignHint: Start and end follow the text: Arabic starts at the right.
formDesign.choicesHint: What is shown, and the value stored when it is chosen.
formDesign.buttonsHint: The value each button stores when it is chosen.
formDesign.detectHint: On a printed form, Mirsam can suggest fields where the page has lines and boxes to fill in. You choose which to make.
formDesign.detectNone: No blanks to fill in were found on page {{page}}.
formDesign.detectReview: Found on page {{page}}: {{n}}. Untick any that are not fields, then make the rest.

editMode.label: What a press on the page does

hint.objects: Press an image, shape or text block to select it, then drag it or its corners.
hint.links: Drag on the page to add a link, or press a link to change it.

objects.hint: Press an object on the page to select it.
objects.selectedHint: Drag to move it, drag a corner to resize it (Shift: freely). Arrow keys move it a point, Shift ten.

refusal.textState: This text changes its own position mid-way and cannot be moved.

objects.cropHint: Drag the corners to choose what to keep. Enter applies, Escape cancels.

links.hint: Drag on the page to draw a link, or select text and choose Link. Press a link to change where it goes.

invalid.url: Enter a web or e-mail address without spaces.
invalid.page: Enter a page number in the document.

actions.destination: A destination that cannot be read
actions.unknown: An action this app does not follow

links.otherReplace: Choose where it should go instead.
links.notOpened: Mirsam does not open this link.

certSign.title: Sign with a certificate
certSign.noIdentities: No certificate yet. Add one from a .p12 or .pfx file.
certSign.keychainHint: Certificates in the macOS keychain are listed too. A certificate added from a file is kept only until Mirsam quits.
certSign.invisible: Invisible: in the file, not drawn on a page
certSign.visible: Visible: a box with your signature, name and date
certSign.placeHint: After you choose Place and sign, click where the box goes.
certSign.tsaHint: Only a fingerprint of the signature is sent, nothing from the document. Your organisation or certificate provider can give you an address.
certSign.tsaMissing: Enter the time-stamping server's address, or turn the time-stamp off.
certSign.saveNote: Signing saves the document. Later changes are added after the signature, which stays valid and shows what changed.
certSign.saveNoteEncrypted: Signing saves the document with its password. Its protection cannot be changed after signing.

signaturesPanel.failed: The signatures could not be checked.
signaturesPanel.none: This document has no digital signatures.

overall.unknown: Signed, but at least one signer could not be verified.
overall.invalid: At least one signature is not valid.

status.unknown: Unchanged, but the signer is not verified

signaturesPanel.unchanged: The document has not changed since it was signed.

changed.annotations: Comments, markup or Fill & Sign items: {{formatted}}
changed.pageOrder: Pages were added, removed or moved

signaturesPanel.revocation: Revocation (a certificate withdrawn before it expired) is not checked yet.

problem.byte_range_invalid: The signed part of the file is not marked out soundly.
problem.digest_mismatch: The document was changed in the part that was signed.
problem.signature_invalid: The signature does not match the signer's key.
problem.certificate_not_bound: The certificate is not the one the signature was made with.
problem.signer_untrusted: The signer's certificate is not from an authority this computer trusts.
problem.signer_expired: The signer's certificate was not valid at the time checked, and no trusted time-stamp proves when it was signed.
problem.key_not_for_signing: The signer's certificate is not meant for signing.
problem.no_certificate: The signature does not carry the signer's certificate.
problem.timestamp_untrusted: Its time-stamp is from an authority this computer does not trust.
problem.signature_unreadable: The signature could not be read.
problem.algorithm_unsupported: The signature uses an algorithm Mirsam does not check (such as SHA-1).
